controls.name: session_cookie_protection
controls.observed: Session cookies are HTTP-only, SameSite=Lax, set with a configured TTL and Secure flag when served over HTTPS; verified in the BFF session issuance and config path.

controls.name: csrf_and_origin_controls
controls.observed: CSRF protection is implemented and observed: state-changing requests require a valid X-XSRF-TOKEN double-submit cookie/header pair and invalid requests are rejected with HTTP 403 before upstream calls. Origin validation is not implemented, because spa-bff never reads the Origin or Referer header to decide whether to accept a request. The control is named for both mechanisms, so it is recorded as pending.

controls.name: actor_binding
controls.observed: Client-supplied X-OKR-Actor values are rejected when they do not match the authenticated session actor for actor-scoped routes.

controls.name: request_signing
controls.observed: BFF-to-backend requests include service token, HMAC signature, timestamp, and nonce headers; invalid or absent signatures are rejected by the backend.

controls.name: route_allowlisting
controls.observed: Only allowlisted browser routes are proxied and non-allowlisted routes return 403 before any backend call is attempted.

controls.name: rate_limiting
controls.observed: No rate limiting is implemented in spa-bff; the package references no limiter, request budget, or abuse threshold. The abuse-resistance behaviour actually observed is fail-closed session handling with bounded error envelopes and no retry loop that bypasses trust mediation. Backend rate limiting exists through OKR_BACKEND_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS and OKR_BACKEND_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS, but it protects the backend hop rather than the browser edge, so it does not satisfy a BFF-boundary control.
